name: Feel No Pain 4+
summary: Feel No Pain X+: each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6; on an X+ (here 4+), that wound is not lost.

name: Firing Deck 16
summary: Firing Deck X: in your Shooting phase, when this Transport shoots, up to X (here 16) embarked models whose units have not yet shot each lend it one ranged weapon (no one-shot); no unit embarked in it can shoot for the rest of the turn.

name: Acrobatic Gladiators (Pain)
summary: At the start of your Charge phase, this unit can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, it is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Aerialists
summary: At the end of the Fight phase, if this TRANSPORT has no embarked models, one friendly DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit of 6 or fewer models (not FLY-capable) wholly within 6" and outside Engagement Range can embark, even the turn it disembarked.

name: Agonising Suppression (Pain)
summary: When this model is selected to shoot, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, after it shoots, select one hit enemy unit, which is suppressed (its attacks suffer -1 to the Hit roll) until your next turn.

name: Airborne Evasion
summary: After this unit shoots, if it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit, it can make a Normal move of up to 6", but is then not eligible to charge that turn.

name: Archon of the Poisoned Tongue (Pain)
summary: When this model's unit is selected to shoot or fight, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, choose Sustained Hits 1 or Lethal Hits for its weapons until the end of the phase.

name: ARCHON’S RETINUE
summary: If a Leader unit is attached to this unit during the Declare Battle Formations step, that Leader gains the Scouts 7" ability.

name: Archon’s Will
summary: At the start of the first battle round, select an objective marker: for the rest of the battle, while this unit is within range of it and not Battle-shocked, its models have a 5+ invulnerable save and Objective Control 3.

name: Assassins’ Poisons (Pain)
summary: When this unit is selected to shoot or fight, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, its weapons (except blast pistols, blasters, and dark lances) have the Lethal Hits and Precision abilities.

name: Battlefield Butchery (Pain)
summary: When this unit is selected to fight, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, its melee weapons gain +1 to their Attacks and Strength characteristics.

name: Bloody Spectacle
summary: Each melee attack this model makes against a Character unit can have both its Hit roll and Wound roll re-rolled, and destroying a Character with this model's unit gains you 1CP.

name: Blur of Blades
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit have the Fights First ability.

name: Brides of Death (Pain)
summary: When this model's unit is selected to fight, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, its melee attacks gain +1 to their Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics.

name: Court of the Archon
summary: While a CHARACTER model is leading a unit that contains one or more Lhamaean, Medusae, Sslyth and/or Ur-ghul models, that CHARACTER model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

name: Cruel Enforcers
summary: At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

name: Deadly Retinue (Pain)
summary: Spend 1 Pain token at the start of Shooting/Fight phase to Empower this unit, gaining a bonus by model type: Lhamaean = melee Lethal Hits; Medusae = ranged Ignores Cover; Sslyth = -1 Wound vs its melee; Ur-ghul = Fights First.

name: Decapitating Strikes (Pain)
summary: When this unit is selected to fight, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, its melee attacks against Infantry units have the Devastating Wounds ability.

name: Devious Mastermind
summary: Once per battle round, one model in your army with this ability can use it when that model's unit is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem is reduced by 1CP.

name: Devoted to Pain
summary: If a model in this unit is equipped with two macro-scalpels, those weapons have the Twin-linked ability.

name: Electromagentic Cascade (Pain)
summary: When this model is selected to shoot, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, its ranged attacks gain Sustained Hits 2 against Vehicle units, or Sustained Hits 1 against other units.

name: Engine of Destruction (Pain)
summary: When this model is selected to shoot, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, its pulse disintegrators have the Rapid Fire 8 ability.

name: Eradicate the Foe
summary: Each time this model makes an attack, if the target is an enemy unit that is at its Starting Strength, you can re-roll that attack's Hit roll.

name: Experimental Enhancements (Pain)
summary: When this unit is selected to fight, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered, choosing until the end of the phase: melee weapons of non-Character models gain an Attacks characteristic of 3, or Attacks 4 with the Hazardous ability.

name: Fade Away (Pain)
summary: At the end of the opponent's Fight phase, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit, it can spend 1 Pain token to be removed from the battlefield and placed into Strategic Reserves.

name: Father of Pain
summary: Each time an attack with a Damage characteristic of 1 is allocated to a model in this model's unit, that model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against that attack.

name: Fear Incarnate (Aura)
summary: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, its Leadership is worsened by 1, and if it is below its Starting Strength it must take a Battle-shock test in the opponent's Command phase.

name: Fleshcraft (Pain)
summary: In your Command phase, you can spend 1 Pain token to Empower this model's unit. Each time you do, you can return up to D3+1 destroyed Bodyguard models to that unit.

name: Goaded Savagery (Pain)
summary: When this unit is selected to fight, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, if it contains a Beastmaster model, its Beast models' melee attacks can re-roll both the Hit and Wound roll.

name: Ground Attack Craft
summary: Each ranged attack a model in this unit makes against an enemy unit that cannot Fly gains +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Hatred Eternal (Pain)
summary: When this model's unit is selected to shoot or fight, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, its attacks can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Horrific Regeneration
summary: The first time this model is destroyed, roll a D6 at the end of the phase: on a 2+ it is set back up near where it fell, outside Engagement Range, with its wounds fully restored.

name: Incubi Shrine Token
summary: Once per battle for each Incubi Shrine token this unit has, change the result of one Hit or Wound roll made for a Klaivex or Incubi model in it to an unmodified 6.

name: Kabalite Icon
summary: While the bearer's unit is not Battle-shocked, the bearer has +1 to its Objective Control characteristic.

name: Lithe Agility (Pain)
summary: When this model's unit Advances or before its Charge roll, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, Advance and Charge rolls made for it can be re-rolled.

name: Macro-steroids (Pain)
summary: When this unit is selected to fight, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, its melee weapons have a Strength characteristic of 8 and the Lethal Hits ability.

name: Master of Blades (Pain)
summary: When this model's unit is selected to fight, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, its melee attacks gain +1 to the Wound roll.

name: Masters of the Shadowed Sky
summary: At the end of your Command phase, if this model is within range of an objective marker you control and has a Kabalite Warriors unit embarked, you retain control of it until the opponent's Level of Control there exceeds yours.

name: Matchless Swiftness (Pain)
summary: When this unit Advances, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, it skips the Advance roll and instead adds 8" to its Move characteristic until the end of the phase.

name: Mind Like a Steel Trap (Aura)
summary: Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit within 12" of this model with a Stratagem, you can increase that Stratagem's CP cost by 1.

name: Mindless Killing Machines (Pain)
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, this unit can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: if a model in it is destroyed by melee before fighting, roll a D6 - on a 2+ it fights after the attacker finishes before being removed.

name: Monstrous Charge
summary: Each time this unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range: roll a D6 per model of this unit within Engagement Range of it, dealing D3 mortal wounds per 4+.

name: MONSTROUS HULKS
summary: This unit cannot embark within a Venom. It can embark within other Drukhari Transports; when it does, each Grotesque model takes up the space of 3 models.

name: Murderous Crossfire
summary: After this unit shoots, select one hit enemy unit (once per turn): until the end of the phase, friendly Drukhari ranged attacks against it have their Armour Penetration improved by 1.

name: Nowhere to Hide (Pain)
summary: When this unit is selected to shoot, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, after it shoots, select one hit enemy unit, which cannot have the Benefit of Cover until the end of the phase.

name: Nowhere to Run (Pain)
summary: When this unit is selected to shoot, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, after it shoots, select one hit non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit, which has -2 Move and -2 to Charge rolls until your next turn.

name: Onslaught
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in it can make Pile-in and Consolidation moves of up to 6" instead of up to 3".

name: Pain Adept
summary: In your Command phase, if a model with this ability is on the battlefield, roll a D6: on a 4+ you gain 1 Pain token.

name: Pain Engine (Aura)
summary: Each time you spend a Pain token to Empower a friendly unit within 9" of this unit, roll a D6 (+1 if this unit has a model without a spirit vortex): on a 5+ you gain 1 Pain token.

name: Pain Parasite (Pain)
summary: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when you select this unit to shoot or fight, you can spend 1 Pain token to Empower this unit. While Empowered, each time this unit shoots or fights, after it has resolved its attacks, if one or more enemy models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, one model in this unit regains up to 3 lost wounds. If all models in this unit have their starting number of wounds and this unit is below its Starting Strength, 1 model is returned to this unit with 3 wounds remaining.

name: Precognisant
summary: After both players deploy, if this model is in your army, select up to three Drukhari units and redeploy them, optionally into Strategic Reserves regardless of normal limits.

name: Rapid Deployment (Pain)
summary: In your Movement phase, when you select this model to Advance, you can spend 1 Pain token to Empower this model. While Empowered, units can disembark from this model after it has Advanced. Units that do so make a shock disembark move (Core Rules, 18.07) for that disembarkation.

name: Sadistic Raiders (Pain)
summary: When this unit is selected to shoot or fight, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, its attacks can re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or re-roll it entirely if the target is within range of an objective marker.

name: Sculptor of Torments (Pain)
summary: When this model's unit is selected to fight, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, its melee attacks gain +1 to the Wound roll.

name: Scything Charge
summary: Each time this model ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range and roll a D6: on 2-3 it suffers D3 mortal wounds, on 4-5 it suffers 3 mortal wounds, on a 6 it suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

name: Shade Weavers
summary: This unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks from a model more than 18" away.

name: Shadowfield
summary: While this model has an invulnerable save, this unit cannot re-roll save rolls; the first time this model loses a wound other than a mortal wound, it has no invulnerable save for the rest of the battle.

name: Shredding Fire (Pain)
summary: When this unit is selected to shoot, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, its ranged weapons have their Armour Penetration increased by 1.

name: Silent Executioner
summary: Each attack this model makes against a unit below its Starting Strength can have its Hit roll re-rolled, and also its Wound roll re-rolled if the target is Below Half-strength.

name: Skyboard Evasion
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends any move within 8" of this unit, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", provided it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit.

name: Soul Trap
summary: The bearer's melee weapons gain +1 to their Attacks and Strength characteristics; the first time the bearer destroys an enemy model in melee, those weapons gain a further +1 to Attacks and Strength for the rest of the battle.

name: Speed of the Kill
summary: Each time a Wyches unit disembarks from this model (except an Emergency Disembarkation), it must be set up wholly within 6" of this model.

name: Splinter Racks (Pain)
summary: When this model is selected to shoot, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, if a unit is embarked within it, its ranged attacks with the Anti ability can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Stimm-needler
summary: Once per turn, the first time a saving throw is failed for a model in the bearer's unit, the Damage characteristic of that attack is changed to 0.

name: Swooping Descent (Pain)
summary: In your Movement phase, spend 1 Pain token to Empower this unit: models set up by Deep Strike need only be more than 6" horizontally from enemy units; if the unit arrives within 8" of an enemy, it cannot declare a charge this turn.

name: Thrilling Spectacle
summary: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, this model can gain a 3+ invulnerable save and change its melee weapons' Attacks characteristic to 12, both until the end of the phase.

name: Torture Device
summary: Each time this unit destroys an enemy unit, you gain 1 additional Pain token.

name: Torturer’s Craft
summary: After this unit shoots or fights, select one hit non-Vehicle enemy unit: it must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Vanguard of the Dark City
summary: At the start of your Command phase, select one ability from this model's Vanguard of the Dark City list; it has that ability until your next Command phase.

name: Visions of Butchery
summary: While one or more Wracks units are embarked within this model, its bladevanes and chainsnares gain +1 Attacks for each embarked Wracks model.

name: Void Mine
summary: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, pick one visible enemy model (not Lone Operative) within 24" of this unit, then roll one D6 for each enemy unit within D6" of that model: on a 4+ that unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

name: Winged Strike (Pain)
summary: When this unit is selected to shoot, it can spend 1 Pain token to become Empowered: while Empowered, its ranged attacks can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Power from Pain
summary: You gain 1 Pain token at the start of your Command phase and 1 whenever an enemy unit is destroyed or fails a Battle-shock test. Spend them as a unit's Pain ability directs to Empower it: all its Pain abilities take effect that phase.
